title: Looking for Players to Try My Indie Game – ArenaShooter!
author: PlayL1keMe
selftext:
Hey everyone!

I've been working on my indie game, **ArenaShooter**, and I'd love to invite you to give it a try!

ArenaShooter is a 2D top-down wave survival shooter where you fight increasingly dangerous enemies, collect XP, level up, and choose upgrades to build your character.

The game is now **fully translated into English**, including all upgrade cards, menus, and in-game text.

I'm looking for players who would be willing to try the game and share their thoughts. Any feedback would be greatly appreciated! I'd especially love to hear your opinions on the gameplay, balance, and overall experience.

I'm an indie developer, and every bit of feedback helps me make the game better.

Thanks for your time, and I hope you enjoy playing ArenaShooter!
